title: Run-scoped expected exception rules
summary: Registered rules include runaway_space DIRECTORY N meg, runtime_overrun N seconds and output_contains NEEDLE [stdout|stderr|both]. They are snapshotted into run approval and checked during that job only.
invariants: 10 meg is 10,000,000 bytes; 10 MiB is 10,485,760 bytes.
Breach is strictly greater than registered size; a sampled 11-meg size breaches 10 meg.
Workspace size is sampled about every 100 ms; short spikes can go unseen.
Exceptions report and do not terminate the process.
Case-sensitive output matches and child exit status are independent facts.
Observation unavailable or over budget cannot count as clean.
Remote space rules require a remote-side observer not supplied by dev8.
